title: Normalized scalar tensor sections, naturality, extensionality and adjunction unit
statement: On any site with module sheafification, let φ:R→S be a ring-sheaf morphism and F a functor identified on objects and maps with the existing sheafified balanced tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pur-cochain-coefficient-arrows]. Define its section tensor by transporting sheafification of s⊗x through the object equality. Maps out of F(M) are determined by values on 1⊗x, tensor sections are natural in M, and transporting the standard scalar-extension adjunction along the tensor presentation gives unit x↦1⊗x. In particular, for the specified scalar functor of [def-weil-ramified-pullback-tower-data] on any scheme pro-etale site, scalarAdjunction_unit and scalar_map_tensor give precisely these normalized formulas in its existing tensor sections. These are proved universal-property facts, not additional comparison assumptions.

source.place: Tag 03EK, section-tensor-product: tensor sheafification and its balanced universal property. The normalized scalar adjunction is the existing def-pur-cochain-coefficient-arrows construction.

proof.text: For a functor F with the specified object equality and map equality, transport pure tensor sections through eqToHom. Cancel that equality isomorphism and apply the sheafification Hom equivalence followed by ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext: maps out of F(M) agree if they agree on 1 tensor x. Naturality follows by the map equality and naturality of the sheafification unit, evaluated on s tensor x.

proof.text: The object equality isomorphisms assemble to a natural tensor presentation by the specified map equality. Transport the existing extension/restriction adjunction along this presentation. Its unit is the transported standard unit. The sheafification adjunction unit and the normalized extension adjunction formula identify it with the sheafification image of 1 tensor x. Specialize to the scalar functor and its actual object/map witnesses; this yields scalar_map_tensor, scalarAdjunction and scalarAdjunction_unit without unfolding the derived coefficient construction. All definitions and every theorem in this module are proved.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarAdjunction_unit {W : Scheme.{t}}
    {R S : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}} (c : R ⟶ S)
    (M : Mod.{t, u} R) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj U) :
    ((scalarAdjunction.{t, u} c).unit.app M).val.app U x = tensor.{t, u} c M U 1 x
